<!-- PHI-DIRECT -->
```powershell
Write-Output '=== DT MERGE 384 - THE WHOLE DATA FOLDER ROAD (Job 380 stands as the record: the archive manifest carries the table itself at D:\OMNI-UE\Content\Data\DT_Dialogue.uasset, no PHIDialogue-named struct asset surfaced anywhere, and the OMNI table load returned None inside both projects - a table whose supporting files stand packed in the same folder cannot load alone. THIS JOB: one, print every archive manifest entry whose original path sits under D:\OMNI-UE\Content\Data\, with its path, its packed form and its bytes. Two, restore all of them into D:\OMNI-UE at their original paths through the kraken tooling, copied never moved, any standing target backed up as .phi-backup-384, restored bytes printed per file, so the table and everything the Data folder holds stand together in their own project. Three, in the OMNI-UE project, load DT_Dialogue, print its row struct name, export through export_to_json_string and print the row census; if the load still returns None, print that verdict and stop. Four, in the merged base at D VEIL-OMNI, back the base table file up as .phi-backup-384 first, load and export the base table, merge with base rows kept and OMNI rows appended only where absent, skips printed, fill through fill_from_json_string, save, re-export and print the full merged census with the total - 37 rows is the shape of done.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 8) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'EDITOR STILL OPEN after 2 min - job deferred.'; Write-Output 'JOB 384 DEFERRED'; return }
$base = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI'
$omni = 'D:\OMNI-UE'
$arch = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI-ARCHIVE'
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$uprojV = Get-ChildItem $base -Filter '*.uproject' -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
$uprojO = Get-ChildItem $omni -Filter '*.uproject' -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
Write-Output ("MERGED BASE PROJECT: " + $uprojV)
Write-Output ("OMNI PROJECT: " + $uprojO)
Write-Output '--- SECTION 1: KRAKEN TOOLING ---'
$tools = 'C:\Users\Admin\phi-vault\phi-dlam\tools\kraken_ton618.py'
if (-not (Test-Path $tools)) { $tools = (Get-ChildItem 'C:\Users\Admin' -Recurse -Depth 5 -Filter 'kraken_ton618.py' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName) }
if (-not $tools) { Write-Output 'KRAKEN TOOLING FILE NOT FOUND ON THIS PC'; Write-Output 'JOB 384 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output "KRAKEN TOOL: $tools"
$py = (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
if (-not $py) { $py = (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source }
if (-not $py) { Write-Output 'PYTHON NOT FOUND'; Write-Output 'JOB 384 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output "PYTHON: $py"
& $py -c "import numpy, zstandard; print('PHI KRAKEN DEPS OK')" 2>&1 | Write-Output
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
  Write-Output 'DEPS MISSING - one install attempt'
  & $py -m pip install numpy zstandard 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3 | Write-Output
  & $py -c "import numpy, zstandard; print('PHI KRAKEN DEPS OK AFTER INSTALL')" 2>&1 | Write-Output
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'TOOLING NOT READY - nothing restored.'; Write-Output 'JOB 384 STOPPED'; return }
}
$toolsDirFwd = (Split-Path $tools) -replace '\\', '/'
Write-Output '--- SECTION 2: MANIFEST DATA ENTRIES + RESTORE INTO OMNI-UE ---'
$pyR = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyR = $pyR.Replace('ZZTOOLSZZ', "'" + $toolsDirFwd + "'").Replace('ZZMANIFESTZZ', "'D:/VEIL-OMNI-ARCHIVE/KRAKEN_MANIFEST.json'").Replace('ZZARCHZZ', "'D:/VEIL-OMNI-ARCHIVE'").Replace('ZZOUTZZ', "'D:/VEIL-OMNI/Saved/phi_dt384_restore_out.txt'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt384_restore.py" -Value $pyR -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt384_restore_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $py "$base\Saved\phi_dt384_restore.py" 2>&1 | Write-Output
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt384_restore_out.txt") { Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt384_restore_out.txt" | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT384 RESTORE OUTPUT FILE'; Write-Output 'JOB 384 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 3: OMNI TABLE EXPORT IN THE OMNI-UE PROJECT ---'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$omni\Saved" | Out-Null
$pyO = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyO = $pyO.Replace('OUTFILE', "'D:/OMNI-UE/Saved/phi_dt384_omni_out.txt'").Replace('JSONOUT', "'D:/OMNI-UE/Saved/phi_dt384_omni_rows.json'")
Set-Content "$omni\Saved\phi_dt384_export.py" -Value $pyO -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$omni\Saved\phi_dt384_omni_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item "$omni\Saved\phi_dt384_omni_rows.json" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uprojO -run=pythonscript -script="$omni\Saved\phi_dt384_export.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$omni\Saved\dt384_export.log"
$oout = $null
if (Test-Path "$omni\Saved\phi_dt384_omni_out.txt") { $oout = Get-Content "$omni\Saved\phi_dt384_omni_out.txt"; $oout | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT384 OMNI OUTPUT FILE'; Write-Output 'JOB 384 STOPPED'; return }
if (($oout -join "`n") -match 'OMNI LOAD NONE') { Write-Output 'PHI DT384 VERDICT: OMNI TABLE STILL UNREADABLE IN ITS OWN PROJECT AFTER THE WHOLE DATA FOLDER RESTORE'; Write-Output 'JOB 384 STOPPED'; return }
if (-not (Test-Path "$omni\Saved\phi_dt384_omni_rows.json")) { Write-Output 'DT384 OMNI ROWS JSON MISSING - merge not run.'; Write-Output 'JOB 384 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 4: MERGE IN THE MERGED BASE ---'
$baseDT = "$base\Content\Data\DT_Dialogue.uasset"
if (Test-Path $baseDT) { Copy-Item $baseDT "$baseDT.phi-backup-384" -Force; Write-Output 'PHI DT384 BASE TABLE FILE BACKED UP (.phi-backup-384)' } else { Write-Output 'PHI DT384 BASE TABLE FILE ABSENT AT EXPECTED PATH - merge commandlet read decides' }
$pyM = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyM = $pyM.Replace('OUTFILE', "'D:/VEIL-OMNI/Saved/phi_dt384_merge_out.txt'").Replace('OMNIJSON', "'D:/OMNI-UE/Saved/phi_dt384_omni_rows.json'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt384_merge.py" -Value $pyM -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt384_merge_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uprojV -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_dt384_merge.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\dt384_merge.log"
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt384_merge_out.txt") { Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt384_merge_out.txt" | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT384 MERGE OUTPUT FILE'; Write-Output 'JOB 384 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output 'JOB 384 DONE'
```
